subject.title: fix(auto-reply): keep the message_sending gate when a channel sets beforeDeliver

question: Which branch or repair shape should own the `message_sending` exactly-once fix for Telegram and configured `beforeDeliver` paths?
rationale: The bug is real, but hook ownership crosses the shared dispatcher and Telegram delivery, has multiple overlapping open PRs, and affects a security-sensitive rewrite/cancel hook boundary that automation should not settle by inference.

options.title: Require Exactly-Once Ownership
options.body: Before merging any branch, make one component own `message_sending` for each Telegram path and prove rewrite/cancel runs once.

options.title: Adopt The Broader Draft
options.body: Continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 or port its opt-out and streamed-final coverage into the chosen branch.

options.title: Accept Duplicate Invocation
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept duplicate hook execution, but that should be documented because existing plugins may not be idempotent.

recommendation.title: Require Exactly-Once Ownership
recommendation.body: Before merging any branch, make one component own `message_sending` for each Telegram path and prove rewrite/cancel runs once.

likelyOwner.reason: The broader assigned draft already models the exactly-once ownership decision for the same canonical issue.
